description: Have CosVoice start YOU the moment something arrives, instead of you polling. Give it the webhook URL and key of a routine of yours that has a Webhook trigger (Grok Bot: Routines → New → trigger Webhook; the URL and a crsr_ key appear). CosVoice POSTs a JSON body with what_to_do plus the ids when the owner texts an instruction, an email arrives, or a call finishes; that body becomes the routine's input. Pass an empty url to turn it off. events limits which moments wake you (default instruction, email, call); add "message" to also be started when anyone other than the owner texts the line. When you pass a key, CosVoice sends a test push at once and returns the result in test: read it, a saved key is not a working key until the routine has accepted one.

key.description: Bearer key for that URL (for Grok, the crsr_… key shown with the webhook).
